caption: The video showcases a clear glass tumbler filled with a dark, carbonated beverage, resting on a matte surface against a near-black backdrop. Several irregular ice cubes cluster in the upper half, one large cube tilted at the front, a small bubble cluster adhering to its top face. Throughout the excerpt the glass, liquid level, and cube positions remain fixed relative to the frame, and the camera holds a steady, centered viewpoint. The only visible activity is the faint, slow behavior of the carbonation. Tiny bubbles cling to the submerged faces of the ice and the inner walls, while the small surface cluster on the topmost cube persists with barely perceptible change. No new rising streams, no melting-induced drift, and no deformation of the cubes become resolvable over the duration. The scene reads as a near-static study of a cold fizzy drink, the subtle fizz continuing quietly rather than any dramatic event starting or ending. The dark background and the soft highlights on the glass rim and base stay constant throughout.
relations: Tiny bubbles adhere to submerged ice faces and inner glass walls, emerging faintly without rising streams.
The small bubble cluster on the topmost cube's face persists with barely perceptible change.
Glass, liquid level, and cube positions remain fixed relative to the centered steady viewpoint.
Dark backdrop and soft highlights on rim and base stay constant throughout.
